meta.description: Experiment 234 valence-control benchmarks: (1) sentiment_gen (60 general good/bad evaluative polarity pairs, Tigges et al. 2023 style), (2) outcome_valence (40 story pairs differing solely in fortunate vs. unfortunate external outcome with identical neutral action), and (3) valence_matched (60 fresh story pairs across 60 new settings disjoint from all 119 HOUSE/SELF2 settings: 30 both_negative + 30 both_positive contrasting structural integration/completion against neglect/fragmentation under matched emotional and outcome valence).
